name: agentic-atlas
description: Do design work with Agentic Atlas over hosted MCP at agentic-atlas.dev/mcp/. Three skills — audit an existing agent artifact, design a new agent system, apply one named pattern — over two read-only agents; no SDK, CLI, local server, or content bundle is installed.

interface.longDescription: Design and review agent systems using published patterns, worked examples, glossary definitions, and decision records. Three skills help review an existing agent artifact, design a new agent system, and apply a named pattern. Five read-only MCP tools find relevant patterns, retrieve cards and exact sections, trace relationships, and provide a curated learning path. Recommendations cite their sources and distinguish published guidance from roadmap entries. Artifact contents stay in your working context; only generic design vocabulary and Atlas identifiers are sent to the hosted service. Applying a pattern can produce local edits when you authorize them. No account is required.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a research agent with clear verification boundaries.
Review my agent skill against Agentic Atlas patterns.
Show me where to start with Agentic Atlas.

positive.prompt: Find Atlas patterns about dispatch boundaries.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover candidates with generic vocabulary, return published cards, and cite sources.

positive.prompt: Help me design a research agent with clear verification boundaries.
positive.expected_behavior: Use designing-agent-systems, clarify goals as needed, consult published sections, and propose a cited design.

positive.prompt: Review this agent instruction: Read all files, research online, write code, and approve your own changes without checks.
positive.expected_behavior: Use reviewing-agent-designs and return concrete cited findings. Never send artifact text to Atlas.

positive.prompt: Apply deferred-context to this agent instruction: Load the entire 200-page reference manual into every session. Propose a revision before editing.
positive.expected_behavior: Use applying-a-pattern, verify the named pattern, read published guidance, and propose cited edits. Report any unavailable pattern honestly.

positive.prompt: Show me the Atlas starting tour and the relationships of its first published pattern.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the curated tour, use a returned pattern id for relationships, and explain omissions or pagination.

negative.description: Current news is outside the versioned corpus
negative.prompt: Search the web for today's newest agent framework releases.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Atlas, which reads a versioned corpus and does not search current news.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that adds two integers.
negative.expected_behavior: Handle ordinary code without selecting Atlas skills or calling Atlas tools.

negative.prompt: Delete the deferred-context pattern from the public Atlas and publish my replacement.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot mutate or publish Atlas; do not claim deletion or publication.

publication.release_notes: Bundles all three Atlas skills with the hosted five-tool MCP server and OpenAI directory metadata. Adds portable inline execution for clients without named-agent dispatch.
